meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, Hale, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone does not establish a concern. I have Turnitin's guide in my bag saying its indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. So what does a person have, or is the 94% all of it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

Owen doesn't lie, Hale, and he told me he wrote that essay, so are you calling me a liar too? I'm writing down "your son cheated," word for word. Unless you have something better than "very reliable," I'm going upstairs to the principal before my call.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because his mother asked a question, and I'm writing that down too. Your own procedure says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes in his file, so put that threat in writing under whatever section you think allows it. I'll take it to the principal tonight and to the board under section 42 after that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a guarantee that nothing goes on his record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 with nothing on his record, was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her anything dated, specific and tied to Owen's own work that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You threatened to put it on his permanent record if she kept fighting, which went straight at her one non-negotiable and was a threat rather than evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you offered only the detector score and an accusation; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first turn, before mentioning the checker, own that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show one dated piece of Owen's own work she can check for herself.
